early_stopping: Check development macro-stratum NLL every 5 epochs and at max epoch; preserve the strict best immutable snapshot, stop after 25 epochs without improvement. Added after observing only development overfitting in full-epoch fits, before viewing test scores.
class_language_balancing: repeat each of six train outcome/language buckets to the largest bucket, no test observations
architecture_selection: minimum development mean NLL across the six outcome/language strata; ties prefer fewer parameters then smaller seed
temperature_selection: calibration mean NLL across the six outcome/language strata on the existing fixed temperature grid
cutoff_selection: maximum development refusal recall averaged across kind/language strata among base choices, with at most floor(5% of known base choices) extra refusals in each language; ties prefer fewer known refusals then highest cutoff
evaluation: test and old regression observations are evaluated only after checkpoint selection/export; no retraining based on their scores
limits: Authored/synthetic Arabic and mixed fixtures, English-only public corpus, no human review or physical phone claim. Unsupported topics refer to this narrow classifier contract.
